The ASU Commitment Scholarship is designed for nonresident students to make an ASU degree more accessible nationwide, open to first-year out-of-state U.S. citizens, regardless of their residency, campus choice, or major.
This scholarship is renewable for eligible students.
Available to out-of-state students enrolled in any degree program on the Phoenix-area campuses, as well as the ASU California Center in Los Angeles.
Can be combined with the New American University Scholarship.
Transfer students are not eligible for the ASU Commitment Scholarship.
Out-of-state transfer students can be automatically considered for a New American University Scholarship upon admission with a minimum 3.0 cumulative transfer GPA.
